description: Anomalies our detectors logged, newest first: drain-shaped payments (each with the share of the wallet's balance it took), retry storms, mint bursts, fleet-funding fan-outs (layering_fan), owner changes under a binding, delegation to unknown code. A detection is a shape with evidence, never a verdict. Filter by agent, kind, severity, time or live incidents only; compact drops the glossaries.

agent.description: Optional agent id (act_8453_N or token id)

compact.description: Leave out the glossaries and tier notes

live_only.description: Only detections that are live incidents

since.description: ISO time; only detections at or after it
